description.en: A short animated video that announces one of your upcoming events, ready for an Instagram story or a portrait post.
description.fr: Une petite vidéo animée qui annonce un de vos prochains événements, prête pour une story Instagram ou une publication portrait.

privacy.en: Nothing is collected about your visitors, and there is no public page. The module keeps your saved models (only the Contacts card number of each guest streamer), your style variants, a short list of one-off people, a yes/no for the “Made with Curiosa” mark and, for 7 days at most, what an assistant prepared. Upcoming events and the people they list are read live (kept under a minute). Names and pictures stay in Contacts. No video is kept: it is made in your browser.
privacy.fr: Rien n'est collecté sur votre public, et il n'y a pas de page publique. Le module garde vos modèles (pour chaque co-streamer, seulement le numéro de sa fiche dans Contacts), vos variantes de style, une courte liste de ponctuels, un oui/non pour la mention « Made with Curiosa » et, 7 jours au plus, ce qu'un assistant a préparé. Les événements à venir et les personnes qu'ils citent sont lus en direct (gardés moins d'une minute). Les noms et photos restent dans Contacts. Aucune vidéo n'est gardée.

mcp.name: story_models
mcp.description: The video models the owner saved for the announcement story (a model = a style, a format, a length, the elements to show, a sentence and guest streamers (people from the owner's Contacts, or typed in for one video), saved under a name). Use it before story_prepare to reuse a model by its name. Read only.

mcp.name: story_next_streams
mcp.description: The next streams found in the owner's calendar (up to 8): a 'key' (to give to story_prepare), the title, the start (UTC, ISO 8601), whether it is a whole-day event, the games and the time zone when known. 'state' is 'ok', 'empty' (no calendar installed, or nothing planned) or 'slow' (the calendar did not answer in time). Calendar only: for every kind of upcoming event (scheduled YouTube videos, Twitch schedule…) use story_events. Read only.

mcp.name: story_events
mcp.description: The upcoming events the owner can make a story for, from ALL active sources (the calendar, scheduled YouTube videos and premieres, the Twitch schedule…), merged, without duplicates, sorted by date and time. Each event has a stable 'id' (to give to story_prepare as 'event'), title, start (UTC, ISO 8601), whole-day flag, time zone when known, type (stream, live, premiere, video, event), source and link. Pages of up to 50 ('next' is the cursor for the following page, at most 200 events in all); 'q' searches the titles and games; 'source' keeps one source. 'sources' says which sources answered ('ok'), need setting up ('setup') or did not answer ('down'). 'state' is 'ok', 'empty' (nothing planned) or 'slow' (no source answered). Read only.

q.description: Words to look for in the titles, games and source names.

source.description: Keep one source only: the 'source' value of an event (for example calendar, youtube, twitch).

cursor.description: The 'next' value of the previous page.

mcp.name: style_variants_list
mcp.description: The owner's saved style variants ("My styles"): a name, a base style among the thirteen, optional colours (accent, accent2, background, text as #rrggbb) and a font (site, sans, serif, mono). Use it before style_variant_create to avoid a name that exists, or to pick one for story_prepare. Read only.

mcp.name: story_prepare
mcp.description: Prepares an announcement story video for the owner and returns a LINK to the admin page with everything already filled in. Nothing is generated or published: the owner opens the link while signed in, checks the animated preview, clicks 'Generate the video' and saves the file (the video can only be made in a browser). Start from a saved model (story_models) and/or give settings. The event is chosen with 'event' (an id from story_events, any source), or the stream with 'stream' ('next' by default, or a key from story_next_streams), or hand-written (streamTitle + streamDate [+ streamTime]); give only one of the three. Writes only a preparation that expires after 7 days. All values are checked; an invalid one is refused with an explanation. 'variant' picks one of the owner's saved style variants.

model.description: Name of a saved model to start from (see story_models).

style.description: neon = glitching neon text; poster = film-poster slide-in; countdown = big rolling numbers (adds the countdown element when 'elements' is not given); minimal = typed letters; broadcast = TV bars and ticker; kinetic = huge slamming type; cinema = film title card; arcade = 8-bit panels; collage = cut-paper zine; geometric = flat shapes on a beat; epic = gilded fantasy frame and banner; arena = slanted team-shooter panels; abyss = cold green space-horror terminal.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the video in seconds (5 to 15, default 15).

elements.description: What to show, taken from: title, when, countdown, game, brand, text, costreamers. Default: all of them except countdown (add it to show the big countdown text).

text.description: Optional custom sentence (up to 140 characters, up to 3 lines). Plain text only.

channelName.description: Optional name shown next to the logo (default: the site name).

language.description: Language of the words written in the video (dates and countdown).

stream.description: 'next' (default) or a key given by story_next_streams.

event.description: An event id given by story_events (any source). Use instead of 'stream'.

streamTitle.description: Hand-written stream: its title (use instead of 'stream').

streamDate.description: Hand-written stream: the day, written YYYY-MM-DD.

streamTime.description: Hand-written stream: the start time, written HH:MM (24 h). Leave out for a whole day.

costreamers.description: Up to 6 Twitch names (4 to 25 letters, digits or _) of guest streamers to show. A name that matches a person in the owner's Contacts is linked to that card (name and picture come from Contacts); any other name is shown for this video only.

watermark.description: Optional. true = add a small 'Made with Curiosa' mark at the bottom of the video; false = none. Default: the owner's own choice (off unless they chose otherwise). Never add it unless the owner asked for it.

variant.description: Optional: the name (or identifier) of a saved style variant from style_variants_list. Its base style becomes the style of the video, with its colours and font; leave 'style' out or give the same base style.

showDay.description: Optional: false shows only the time, without the day (useful for a story the same day); true shows the day too. An all-day event keeps its day. Without it, the video starts with the owner's setting 'Show the day with the time' (on by default).

mcp.name: style_variant_create
mcp.description: Create a style variant: the same animation as one of the thirteen styles, with its own colours and font, saved under a name so it shows as a card in the style step of the announcement story. 'style' is the base style. Colours must be #rrggbb or #rgb; a colour that would be hard to read is adjusted automatically and listed in 'adjusted'. At most 30 variants; names must be different. The owner can change or delete it in the administration (My styles tab). It cannot delete anything and cannot make a video.

name.description: A short name, for example 'Geometric night'.

accent.description: Main colour, #rrggbb or #rgb. An empty text removes it (the site colour is used).

background.description: Background colour, same form. Only some styles read it (minimal, geometric).

text.description: Text colour, same form. Only the minimal style reads it.

font.description: Letters: the site's own, a plain sans, a serif or a monospace. Styles with letters of their own (film, arcade, paper, epic) keep them.

mcp.name: style_variant_update
mcp.description: Change a saved style variant, found by its name or identifier (see style_variants_list). Only the fields you give change; an empty text for a colour removes that colour. Same rules as for creation (colours, adjustment, unique names). Videos and models that use the variant keep working. It cannot delete anything.

accent.description: Main colour, #rrggbb or #rgb. An empty text removes it (the site colour is used).

background.description: Background colour, same form. Only some styles read it (minimal, geometric).

text.description: Text colour, same form. Only the minimal style reads it.

font.description: Letters: the site's own, a plain sans, a serif or a monospace. Styles with letters of their own (film, arcade, paper, epic) keep them.

fr.mcp.style_variants_list: Les variantes de style enregistrées par la personne (« Mes styles ») : un nom, un style de départ parmi les treize, des couleurs facultatives (principale, secondaire, fond, texte en #rrggbb) et des lettres (site, simple, serif, mono). À lire avant style_variant_create pour éviter un nom déjà pris, ou pour en choisir une pour story_prepare. Lecture seule.
fr.mcp.style_variant_create: Crée une variante de style : la même animation qu'un des treize styles, avec ses propres couleurs et ses propres lettres, gardée sous un nom pour apparaître comme une carte à l'étape du style de la story d'annonce. « style » est le style de départ. Les couleurs s'écrivent #rrggbb ou #rgb ; une couleur difficile à lire est ajustée automatiquement et listée dans « adjusted ». 30 variantes au plus, aux noms différents. La personne peut la modifier ou la supprimer dans l'administration (onglet Mes styles). Ne supprime rien et ne fabrique aucune vidéo.
fr.mcp.style_variant_update: Modifie une variante de style enregistrée, retrouvée par son nom ou son identifiant (voir style_variants_list). Seuls les champs donnés changent ; un texte vide retire la couleur. Mêmes règles qu'à la création (couleurs, ajustement, noms uniques). Les vidéos et modèles qui utilisent la variante continuent de marcher. Ne supprime rien.
